user.title: MikroTik router
user.description: The router that hands out DHCP leases to the miners and holds the firewall block lists.

asic.title: Miner web credentials
asic.description: Digest-auth credentials for the miners' web UI. Antminer defaults are root / root.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the RouterOS REST API. Check that /ip service www (or www-ssl) is enabled and permits Home Assistant's IP.

abort.already_configured: This router is already set up.

data.probe_unknown: Probe unknown DHCP leases for miners
data.fail_threshold: Consecutive polls before raising a problem

data_description.probe_unknown: Finds miners that never publish a DHCP hostname (e.g. Antminer L9) by asking each unknown lease whether it answers the miner CGI API.
data_description.fail_threshold: Guards against single-poll blips raising false alarms.
data_description.allow_pool_write: set_miner_conf.cgi replaces the miner's whole config. Leave off unless you need it.

block.name: Block internet
block.description: Cut the miner's WAN access at the router.

reboot.name: Reboot
reboot.description: Reboot the miner via its web API.

on.name: On
on.description: Turn the LED on or off.

block_rack.name: Block rack
block_rack.description: Cut WAN access for every miner in a rack.

unblock_rack.name: Unblock rack
unblock_rack.description: Restore WAN access for every miner in a rack.

reboot_rack.name: Reboot rack
reboot_rack.description: Reboot every miner in a rack, optionally spaced out in time.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.description: Seconds to wait between miners so the load ramps instead of stepping.

assign_name.name: Assign name
assign_name.description: Give a permanent name to a miner that reports no DHCP hostname, keyed by MAC.

set_pools.name: Set pools
set_pools.description: Rewrite the miner's pool list. Requires the pool-write option to be enabled.

pools.name: Pools
pools.description: List of up to three pools, each with url, user and pass.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Poll the router and every miner immediately.
